name: Alphabet Inc.
research_rationale: Anthropic’s record IPO and a Quaise geothermal PPA for future datacentre power extend AI-infrastructure spend, but unchanged TTM FCF ~$19.7bn and no new filings leave research only modestly aligned with the buy screen.
